headline: Pre-heat gate failed — restart from prep_ladder, re-run mini
notes: Failed before heat dynamics (0 heat steps after mini artifacts). Typical causes: hybrid GRMS above the MLpot registration limit ('not ML-safe'), or geometry gates (intra/extent) after mini.
Try --dynamics-intra-rescue-sd-steps 400 or slightly relax --dynamics-intra-min-distance (e.g. 0.95) if the log shows intra contacts; if it shows 'not ML-safe' GRMS, fix spacing/box.
command: mmml md-system --config md_system.yaml --output-dir artifacts/md_run --backend pycharmm --restart-from /mmhome/boittier/home/mmml_tutorial/acodcm/artifacts/md_run/baseline.res --md-stages mini,heat,nve --dynamics-intra-rescue-sd-steps 400
config_yaml:
# Suggested resume config (generated by mmml md-system)
# prior job: md_run exit=2
# base config: md_system.yaml
include:
  - md_system.yaml

defaults:
  backend: 'pycharmm'
  dynamics_intra_rescue_sd_steps: 400
  md_stages: 'mini,heat,nve'
  output_dir: 'artifacts/md_run'
  restart_from: '/mmhome/boittier/home/mmml_tutorial/acodcm/artifacts/md_run/baseline.res'
shell_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Suggested resume (wrap with ./scripts/mmml-charmm-mpirun.sh on GPU nodes).
# prior job: md_run exit=2
CMD=(
  mmml
  md-system
  --config
  md_system.yaml
  --output-dir
  artifacts/md_run
  --backend
  pycharmm
  --restart-from
  /mmhome/boittier/home/mmml_tutorial/acodcm/artifacts/md_run/baseline.res
  --md-stages
  mini,heat,nve
  --dynamics-intra-rescue-sd-steps
  400
)
exec "${CMD[@]}"
